en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 440 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Hasan bin Ali bin Faddal from Thalaba from Shuaib Haddad from Salih that he said:
I heard Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) say: “There will be only a gap of fifteen days between the rising of the Qaim of Aale Muhammad and the killing of the Pure Soul (Nafse Zakiyyah).”
